question: What claim of certainty is made about the manner in which death is destroyed?
premises: The speaker states an intention to tell something.
No doubt is to remain about that matter.
The matter is the manner in which death is destroyed.
inference: The speaker tells, without doubt, how death is destroyed.
uncertainties: The manner itself is not specified in this verse
plain_english: I tell it; there is no doubt, as death is destroyed.
